summary: TRACORA is an interactive digital space museum and exploration map created by team ZENTHRA for the NASA Space Apps Challenge ("Abandoned but not Forgotten"). Our project bridges the gap between historical space engineering and young minds by bringing NASA's retired rovers, landers, and scientific instruments back to life. Through an immersive, story-driven web platform featuring the Moon and Mars, we transform dense technical archives into engaging first-person narratives. TRACORA inspires school-age space enthusiasts to explore the rich history of off-world artifacts and connects humanity's past achievements with future space pioneers.
details: TRACORA is a web-based interactive experience designed to make space exploration history accessible and engaging for school-age learners. Developed using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript, the platform features a dual-planet interactive map (Moon and Mars) and a digital museum gallery. It uses first-person storytelling to present real historical mission data of abandoned hardware (such as Apollo modules and Mars rovers). Team ZENTHRA focused on intuitive navigation, rich visual design, and educational impact to spark curiosity in the next generation.
